name: Prince Basile
source:
The prince and future king of the country, he throws a masquerade ball to honor his late father's wish to marry before his coronation. He wants to find an intelligent and strong woman capable of ruling as queen and helping him realize his reforms. 

Basile may be Cinders' potential love interest and/or husband depending on the player's choices.
